note: THE SUITE'S GROUPS. A group is a selection of central cells (rola_devtools.cells) and its relation: what it holds, in words, recorded with every session; `equal`, the parameters its cells share, checked when the file loads; and `together`, the arm sets each timed in one session -- every instance's arms of the set on the group's cells each accepts. Carry groups hold tokens and value width and name the RoLA state count, and time each rola subject beside attention on the group's QKV cell; a layer group is one central layer input under one of RoLA's constructions.
